name: Seila
about: Seila is Gladias's wife, a Veridian blogger who writes on economics and culture, and one of the book's three leads. The book describes nothing of her appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: I'm looking forward to your blog
maybe figure out some blog post to write on the United Cities
facts.fact: Travels to Freetown to write about the United Cities.
Seen by Zei and Bai as a woman tourist in Freetown, in ordinary clothes.

facts.quote: Seila put on one of Gladias's privacy robes.
facts.fact: Not an Order member; borrows Gladias's privacy robe for secret errands.

facts.quote: Hopefully the privacy robes will suffice, Gladias thought.
facts.fact: Wears a privacy robe for a security-sensitive walk later in the book.

facts.quote: she had become almost as accustomed to having all of her conversations through neck bands as Gladias had been
facts.fact: Uses a neck band later in the book.

facts.quote: as she was pouring herself a tea
